title: Inspect selected code and return to the originating Item
preconditions: Use public CLI browser fixture: Pipeline System→Store evidence src/app.go 3-5 with greeting-store/store selecting only line 4.

steps.action: Open the Item's technical explanation and inspect greet-only selection.
steps.expected_result: The path shows Pipeline→Store, exactly one referenced line is shown, digest integrity matches, and whole-definition code is separately labeled.

steps.action: Open Store member, return to the prior explanation, then close it.
steps.expected_result: Member view has no Item selection; back restores greet-only; close restores the originating control and exact slide URL.

steps.action: Inspect the code caption, then repeat with stale and unavailable exact references.
steps.expected_result: The displayed code identifies full commit/path/range and marks stale/unresolved without substituting other source.
